name: Nomura Reiri
source:
A mysterious person, found on SHEEPIII's underwater voyage after the tragedy has occurred.

[spoiler]The sister of [url=https://vndb.org/c61547]Touri[/url]. Quite arrogant and sarcastic. Being proactive, cool and smart, she is ready to make the necessary decisions, even if it does mean sacrificing lives. Having enough knowledge and skills, she is competent enough to put her plans into practice. Her main obstacle is the weakness of her body. She has no qualms about utilizing others to achieve her goals. Nevertheless, her desire to keep [url=https://vndb.org/c61547]her sister[/url] safe is strong and genuine.

Reiri got a ticket on this particular voyage due to being a person related to the project. She is a talented programmer and is the one who wrote SHEEPIII's core systems. Using her connections, she also obtained a ticket for her sister, [url=https://vndb.org/c61547]Touri[/url], who had expressed interest in joining the voyage. The true goal of Reiri is to control the COOS network and thus obtain an "oracle." With the use of it, she could get unique data about outer space. There is a method to manage the COOS network—to suppress it with the use of the Alice virus. In order to acquire the virus, Reiri played a part in the plan to bring Alice-carrier, [url=https://vndb.org/c61548]Saihouji Rumi[/url], on board, cooperating with her father. Her role was to create a backdoor in SHEEPIII's systems. Nevertheless, unbeknownst to her, [url=https://vndb.org/c61552]the protagonist[/url] used that backdoor to hack the system and rewrite the program. This has led to the tragedy. Reiri has information about the horrific dangers that SHEEPIII will face underwater. [i]Yet little did she know, that impending nightmare could be stopped no more...[/i]

In the past, right before the "Fourth Day" incident, she visited an oceanarium with her family: her mother and [url=https://vndb.org/c61547]sister[/url]. On the way back, a supernova explosion of Betelgeuse occurred, which led to a massive traffic incident. It entangled Reiri and her family as well. Reiri is fully aware that [url=https://vndb.org/c61547]her sister[/url] swapped her black triage tag with her mother's red one. After that day, she got the determination to protect [url=https://vndb.org/c61547]Touri[/url] and the only way to do that was to use knowledge. But the most coveted knowledge for her was a truly unique one that anyone would want to obtain. Reiri lived only with knowledge. Days after days, she read books and learned, occasionally conducting experiments. She eventually began utilizing a particular medicine to remain active for the full six days of a week. It was an exchange of health for time.[/spoiler]
